existing production models, monitor forecast quality metrics

Bionorica, with approximately 2.200 employees worldwide, is the German market leader in over-the-counter herbal medicines. For over 90 years, we have been unlocking the secrets of nature by combining the knowledge of traditional medicinal plant therapy with pioneering results from scientific research. "Phytoneering" is the formula for our success, which has kept us on a growth trajectory for years. This is how we open up new markets with innovative, highly effective herbal medicines.   To strengthen our Global Brand Management team, we are looking for a creative and strategic (Senior) Global Brand Manager / Teamlead - Franchise Head (m/f/d) who will take responsibility for our Respiratory (Sinupret) or Women´s Health (Canephron) products. These are the tasks for this position: Development of a mid-term vision, ambition, and strategy for our brands in the Respiratory (Sinupret) or Women´s Health (Canephron) products sector, taking into account country-specific market conditions and cultural differences Design and maintenance of brand identity, ensuring brand consistency across all channels Responsibility for the entire brand experience throughout the product lifecycle Conducting analysis of campaign results and consumer insights for continuous improvement Management and maintenance of global brand books to ensure a consistent brand presence Conducting market and consumer research to derive actionable insights Leading the product portfolio and lifecycle management (LCM) to maximize market success Planning and monitoring brand budgets to ensure financial efficiency Sharing, reusing, and leading the global brand community to promote best practices Developing and implementing strategies to increase brand awareness and attractiveness Creating core creative ideas and campaigns to support our global brand strategy Defining compelling brand stories based on deep consumer insights Close collaboration with relevant country colleagues Depending on experience, qualifications and organizational needs, the role may include team leadership responsibility, contributing to the development of franchise priorities, capability building, and the successful delivery of business objectives These are the requirements you should meet: Completed studies in Marketing, Business Administration, or similar experience Several years of experience in brand management, ideally in the pharmaceutical or herbal sector Proven track record in developing and implementing brand strategies and campaigns Strong analytical skills and experience in conducting market research Creativity combined with a strategic approach Ideally first experiences with the How Brands Grow approach on evidence-based marketing Ability to work in a dynamic international environment and lead cross-functional teams (Optional: Previous experience leading a team)  Proficiency in English (both written and spoken), basic German Knowledge would be an Advantage We offer you: A globally operating, family-owned company with a commitment to social responsibility Flexible working hours and home office options to support the balance between work and personal life Responsible fields of activity with a thorough onboarding process and performance-based compensation with attractive social benefits and company pension plan Exciting prospects in a globally growing company with diverse professional and personal development opportunities Are you open to new opportunities? Then take your chance. Please apply through our online application form. We look forward to meeting you!   Compensation - Global Brand Manager : Compensation is governed by the company's collective bargaining agreement, which is aligned with the German Chemical Industry Collective Pay Agreement (BETV Chemie). The anticipated salary grades are: Global Brand Manager: Pay Grade E 10/6 K to E 12/6 K, depending on qualifications and professional experience Senior Global Brand Manager: Pay Grade E 13 K The monthly gross salary for a full-time position (39.5 hours/week) ranges from approximately 5.422EUR (E 10/6 K) to 6.819EUR (E 13 K), depending on the applicable pay grade. In addition, employees may be eligible for an above-tariff allowance, a performance-related bonus linked to target achievement, and further benefits in accordance with company policies. Compensation - Team Lead : This position is compensated outside the scope of the collective bargaining agreement. The starting salary is determined based on a current market benchmark and the candidate's profile and is expected to range between 96.000EUR and 105.000EUR gross per annum, depending on qualifications and experience. In addition, employees are eligible for a performance-related bonus linked to target achievement, as well as benefits in accordance with company policies. WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Join our international financial reporting team as a Financial Accountant. In this role, you are responsible for the general ledger and act as a crucial interface in finance.

- Business Transactions: As a Financial Accountant you process transactions within general ledger, lease and asset accounting, and reconcile with sub-ledgers.
- Financial Statements: Moreover, you prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFRS and local GaaP standards, and support income tax calculations.
- Reporting: You manage monthly group reporting for European BASF Group companies and respond to internal and external reporting inquiries.
- Central Contact: In addition, you serve as the main contact on accounting matters for subsidiaries, other departments at the hub, central financial units of BASF as well as the external auditor.
- Project Involvement: You actively participate in projects and collaborate on the technical, procedural and cultural development of our organization.
- degree in business administration / apprenticeship with a focus on accounting or an equivalent degree
- good knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel and ideally experience with SAP R/3 and S/4HANA
- very good knowledge of English and Polish, German language skills are a plus
- high motivation to achieve joint success in a team
- independent way of working and analytical thinking characterize your working style
- you are enthusiastic about automation and digitization of processes

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualification and work experience. In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success as well as individual performance
- Structured onboarding including a buddy to help ease your transition into the BASF world
- Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location
- Development discussions and programs so that you can reach your full potential
- Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs
- Location-independent work models with defined days of presence in Berlin and place of residence in Germany - here a first impression

HOW TO REACH US

- Jennifer Weiz (Talent Acquisition), jennifer.weiz@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-56454 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are welcome to book an online appointment
- You can also reach our recruiting team on.basf.com/contact

Apply Now
(Senior) Human Resources Recruitment Consultant (f/m/d), 12 months limited contract

Date: 09/03/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

Location Requirement: this is a Germany-based role following SAP’s hybrid work policy; candidates are expected to be based within commutable distance of one of our offices in Walldorf, Berlin, or Munich (Garching) for occasional on-site activities.

SAP supports relocation for this position and will assist successful candidates with the moving process.

What you’ll build:

As a (Senior) Human Resources Recruitment Consultant (f/m/d), you’ll join a culturally diverse regional team of Talent Discovery professionals supporting SAP in Germany. You will shape end-to-end recruiting - from requisition approval and profile definition with local and international hiring managers, through direct and indirect sourcing in the external marketplace, to candidate assessment/selection and complex offer negotiations.

Your tasks will include, but are not limited to:

- 
Own the full hiring process to fill vacancies against time, quality, and service expectations

- 
Partner closely with lines of business to define search strategies and plan external sourcing activities for both internal and external candidates

- 
Execute active sourcing of candidates (e.g. targeted outreach, talent pooling, market mapping) as a core, ongoing part of the role

- 
Act as the subject matter expert on industry talent markets and trends for your assigned business areas

- 
Drive consistent, high-quality candidate and stakeholder experiences across the recruiting lifecycle

What you bring:

- 
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or a related field OR completed vocational training/apprenticeship with a clear recruiting focus required

- 
2–5 years of recruiting experience in a recruitment agency and/or an international company

- 
Understanding of the German talent market and software development functional domains (e.g. Product Development, Software & Cloud Engineering ideally with AI background), covering market mapping, pipeline building, and competitive intelligence

- 
Fluent business-level English (written and spoken). German is a plus

- 
Strong consulting skills with a customer- and results-focused mindset

- 
Proven, proactive outreach to talent via platforms such as LinkedIn (e.g., direct sourcing, talent pooling, pipeline building)

- 
Experience representing an employer on the external labour market (e.g., events, networking, employer branding touchpoints) Process orientation, attention to detail, and accountability across end-to-end recruiting

- 
First experience with competency-based interviewing and recruitment practices

- 
Cross-cultural awareness and effective interpersonal and communication skills, paired with a genuine passion for recruiting. Ability to manage demanding workloads and competing priorities is a benefit

- 
Project coordination or administrative project management experience is a plus

Where you belong

You’ll belong to a supportive Talent Acquisition community that collaborates across regions and business areas to hire great people for SAP. In a truly inclusive culture, we don’t just make room for different perspectives - we seek them out, because better questions lead to better answers. Here, your voice matters and your ideas are heard.

We value clarity, empathy, and teamwork, while giving you the autonomy to make a real impact.

You’ll stretch your expertise in a global, innovative company that turns curiosity into impact and learning into momentum, so you can do work that matters with people who care.

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.

The role

As a Lead Photographer in the HelloFresh Studio, you are part of our Photography team, working across food, product, lifestyle, and marketing productions. You are first and foremost an exceptional photographer with deep technical and visual expertise, setting the benchmark for photographic quality, craft, and production excellence across the Studio.

You lead through expertise, influence, and example, helping elevate the capabilities of the photography team while maintaining high standards across large-scale asset production. You play a key role in developing photographic talent, evolving ways of working, and driving continuous improvement.

You collaborate closely with Producers, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to deliver high-quality and scalable visual production across multiple brands. You stay up to date with industry developments and actively support AI direction, experimentation, and content generation initiatives within the Studio and broader organization, helping translate new technologies into practical production workflows.

What you’ll do

- Lead by exampleand continuously raise the bar for photographic quality and execution across the Studio
- Execute and oversee food, product, lifestyle, and marketing photography to the highest commercial standards
- Coach, mentor, and support photographersthrough feedback, knowledge sharing, and hands-on guidance to elevate overall team capability
- Define, maintain, and continuously improvephotographic standards, shooting guidelines, and best practices
- Work together with Studio leadership to improve production quality, studio efficiency, and scalable ways of working
- Collaborateclosely with Art Direction, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to ensure strong and consistent visual execution
- Support complex productionsand solve creative and technical and production challenges on set
- Drive consistencyacross large asset volumes while maintaining visual excellence and operational efficiency
- Actively contribute to Studio and company AI initiativesby supporting experimentation, developing practical use cases, and helping integrate AI-supported and hybrid content creation workflows
- Act as a trusted expertand escalation point for photographic quality, technical decision-making, and production excellence

What you’ll bring

- You are a seasoned photography professional with 7+ years of experience in commercial photography, ideally including food, lifestyle, product, and high-volume e-commerce content production
- You demonstrate exceptional photography craft and technical excellence. Providing a portfolio is mandatory
- You have deep expertise in lighting, composition, camera systems, color, production environments, and visual storytelling
- You have experience operating in fast-paced production environments and collaborating across multiple disciplines and stakeholders
- You naturally elevate others through coaching, feedback, mentorship, and sharing best practices
- Experience leading photographers or creative production teams is a plus
- You are highly influential, collaborative, and comfortable aligning stakeholders without relying on hierarchy

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Global Head of Procurement & Logistics (f/m/d) for Digital Grid (DG), you will lead the global procurement and logistics organization and shape the function as a strategic business partner, value creator, and digital innovator. You will define and execute DG's global procurement and logistics strategy, strengthen supply chain resilience, drive operational excellence, and accelerate the adoption of AI, data, and digital technologies across the end-to-end value chain.

You will partner closely with business leaders, engineering, operations, finance, logistics, and digitalization teams to build a future-ready operating model that improves competitiveness, delivery reliability, compliance, and sustainable business performance.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Define and execute a global procurement and logistics strategy that aligns with business objectives, ensuring growth, profitability, and delivery commitments.
* Build and manage a high-performing global supplier ecosystem, driving supplier development and risk mitigation strategies to enhance material availability and business continuity.
* Champion the transformation of procurement and logistics into a data-driven function by identifying and scaling AI use cases to enhance decision-making and business performance.
* Deliver measurable business value through cost optimization, productivity improvements, and logistics efficiency, while fostering a culture of ownership, integrity, excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Lead and develop a globally distributed team, focusing on building high-performing cross-functional teams and strengthening future capabilities through talent development and inclusive leadership.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, connecting business strategy with procurement and logistics execution to drive overall organizational success.

What You Bring

* A degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Economics, Logistics, or a related field; equivalent practical experience is equally valued.
* Many years of experience in procurement, supply chain, logistics, or strategic sourcing within a global industrial or technology-driven organization.
* Several years of success in leading global and cross-functional teams, managing stakeholders across various regions and functions.
* Experience leading or contributing to analytics, automation, AI, or digital transformation initiatives in procurement, supply chain, logistics, operations, or a comparable environment.
* Strong commercial, financial, contractual, supplier management, negotiation, and risk-management expertise.
* Proficient communication in English with the ability to translate business needs into practical priorities, decisions, and measurable outcomes.

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. What you’ll build

As part of the Industry AI unit for Energy and Natural Resources, your focus will be on the architecture, design, and technical delivery of solutions and agents in the areas of market communication and metering concept management/distributed energy resources. Working side by side with a dedicated team of Product Experts who define regulatory scope, you will translate product requirements into scalable, cloud-native software architectures and guide your development team from design to production.
You will own the end-to-end technical solution for regulatory update cycles and new agentic use cases, ensuring that system design decisions balance correctness, performance, and maintainability. You drive architectural governance, evaluate technology choices, and act as the primary technical point of contact for all development teams on a day-to-day basis.
Direct engagement with customers on technical requirements and solution design is an important and integral part of your work.
This role requires a combination of deep technical expertise, systems thinking, and strong communication skills in German and English.

What you bring

You have several years of hands-on experience in software architecture and development, ideally in the utilities or energy industry. You have a deep understanding of the technical landscape underpinning German energy market communication — from message exchange to smart meter gateway integration — and you stay informed about relevant regulatory and technology trends. Based on your architectural expertise, your knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and your strong analytical skills, you design solutions that are both technically sound and valuable to customers.

Required skills & experiences:

- Proven experience designing and delivering software solutions for utility customers, with a solid understanding of market communication processes and related regulations.
- Hands-on experience in translating product requirements and regulatory changes into concrete technical designs, implementation plans, and actionable engineering tasks.
- Strong understanding of Agentic AI, SAP Business AI, and modern AI engineering capabilities, including their practical application in industry-specific technical architectures.
- Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor development teams, set architectural direction, and align cross-functional stakeholders on technical trade-offs and delivery priorities.
- Strong consulting and results orientation with the ability to structure technical ambiguity, evaluate architectural options, and guide teams from initial design to validated implementation.
- Proactively use AI in daily engineering workflows to accelerate design, code reviews, testing, automation, and quality assurance of results.
- Excellent knowledge of German and English.

Where you belong

You will be part of the Industry AI unit for Energy and Natural Resources, a team focused on turning Industry AI opportunities in the ENR space into measurable customer value.
In this role, you’ll help raise engineering standards beyond your immediate responsibility by driving architectural best practices, fostering an AI-powered development culture, and enabling your team to deliver with confidence and speed.
If you want to shape the technical foundation of solutions that run critical energy infrastructure and are ready to take Industry AI for ENR from architecture to AI-supported implementation, this role is a great fit for you.
Key competencies in this role include agentic engineering, agentic orchestration, AI-assisted engineering, cloud architecture, cloud security architecture, CI/CD, evaluation and benchmark engineering, scalability design, semantic retrieval, systems thinking, and technical leadership. In addition, you have experience in the daily use of agentic AI as well as in promoting AI adoption in engineering organizations.
Other skills used in this role: Collaboration, Complex Problem Solving, Creative Thinking, Effective Communication, Learning Agility, Agentic AI Day-to-Day Practice, AI Adoption Capability, AI Output Quality Assurance, Context Engineering, AI-Assisted Automation and Prototyping.
